games.name: Sonic.EXE: The Disaster Eclipsed v1.4
games.desc:
Sonic.EXE: The Disaster Eclipsed v1.42

Sonic.EXE: The Disaster Eclipsed is a recreation of its predecessor [Sonic.EXE: The Disaster by Outlaik], with new survivors, new executioners and new abilities. 
Defend yourself as a survivor against the executioner with up to 6 friends, working together to survive until those who remain can escape. Or slaughter the opposing survivors as the executioner to prevent them from escaping.

Updated character info and a full changelog can be found to the left and back in the lobby.
Clunky gameplay and bugs may still be present, I'm still fixing it all as I go.
Bugfixes and additions to the game might be made, but more than one addition being made at a time is unlikely.
[This game may contain loud sounds and music]

A big thanks to the TD:Reborn team for the original game code, and to Outlaik for creating the original Sonic.EXE: The Disaster!

games.name: Project Lazarus: 💀 ZOMBIES 💀
games.desc:
Survive the endless waves of zombie hordes in this cooperative shooter. Earn points by killing zombies and repairing barricades. Get better weapons and open up new areas before the undead overrun you.

Project Lazarus: Zombies is the spiritual successor to my old zombies game. Inspired by classic wave-based Call of Duty Zombies.

Controls:
Interact - [F] / Hold [Button X]
Fire - [Left Mouse Button] / [Right Trigger]
Aim Down Sights - [Q] / [Right Mouse Button] / [Left Trigger]
Reload - [R] / [Button X]
Switch Weapon - [1], [2], [3], [Scroll Wheel] / [Button Y], [Button B]
Sprint - Hold [Left Shift] / [Left Stick Button]
Knife - [V] / [Right Stick Button]
Inspect - [B] / [DPad Left]
Settings - [P] / [DPad Down]
Scoreboard - [Tab] / [DPad Right]

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, Xbox, & PlayStation.
❤️ Like, Favorite, and Follow the game to receive notifications when I update the game!
⚠️ Exploiters will be permanently banned.
